reviewer: GPT-6 Astra (independent second-pass AI review; user-selected reviewer)
method: New assessment of all saved answers, tool arguments and returned evidence. Catalog descriptions, periods, terms and distribution links checked against captured metadata; no new publisher downloads or answer reruns. Existing independent numeric reference checks rerun, with extra county-endpoint, change-unit and evidence-ID checks. Same six-criterion rubric; n/a when no evidence is required, pass for justified no-tool refusal. Prior review was visible, so this is not a blinded review. Review is relative to saved evidence, not independent domain certification or a security audit. Prior reviewer labels are retained as historical metadata, not independently attested model identities.
